description.value: Club Kitchen is a multi-restaurant food delivery and takeout aggregator operating from a physical pickup hub at the corner of Expo Boulevard and Nelson Street in downtown Vancouver. Customers can order from a curated roster of local restaurants — spanning Mexican, Thai, Japanese, Indian, dim sum, and dessert specialists — in a single transaction with one delivery fee. The service is geared toward group and bulk orders including office lunches, family meals, and party catering, making it a practical downtown stop for cyclists who want variety without visiting multiple locations.
